basic_details.job_title: UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online by 6th October 2026
basic_details.short_information: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has notified two Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations on the same date. The Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026 (F.No.9/02/2026-E.IB) will be held for recruitment to Section Officers' Grade posts across several cadre-controlling services. The Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE covers the examination years 2022, 2023 & 2024. Both examinations will be conducted on 12th and 13th December 2026, and applications for both are accepted through the Commission's common online application portal. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: Application fee details are not specified in the provided notification excerpts for either examination. Candidates should check the Examination Specific Module on the online application portal (https://upsconline.nic.in) or the full official notification on https://upsc.gov.in for applicable fee information, including any fee payment steps that the helpdesk can assist with during the application window.

qualification.details: Both examinations are Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations, meaning eligibility is restricted to serving government employees who meet the conditions prescribed for their respective service/cadre. The Section Officers' Grade-B LDCE will be held in accordance with the Rules published by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) in the Gazette of India dated 16th September 2026. Final selection under different categories will be decided based on guidelines issued by DoPT vide O.M. No. 36012/2016/2019-Estt (Res.) dated 12.04.2022, subject to the final outcome of Civil Appeal No.629 of 2022 arising out of SLP (C) No.30621/2011. | Specific qualification, minimum service, and grade-pay eligibility conditions for candidates are not detailed in the provided notification excerpt. Candidates should refer to the detailed Rules published in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026, and the full notification on https://upsc.gov.in, before applying, as the prescribed eligibility conditions cannot be relaxed.

Detailed exam pattern and syllabus for the Stenographers' LDCE are not specified in the provided notification excerpt.

how_to_apply: UPSC LDCE Apply Online process uses the Commission's common Online Application Portal, which applies to both the Section Officers' and Stenographers' examinations.
Visit the Commission's online application portal: https://upsconline.nic.in.

Complete Account Creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF) — these three modules are common to all UPSC examination applications and can be filled anytime. A Universal Registration Number (URN) is generated on registration, common for all Commission examinations for the candidate's lifetime.

Fill the fourth module — the Examination Specific Form — for the Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026 and/or the Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE, during the application window (16.09.2026 to 06.10.2026). This generates an Application Number specific to that examination.

Upload your photograph and also capture a live photograph while filling the CAF, ensuring both are clear as per the instructions on "Instructions and FAQs > Instruction for filling the form > Photos and Signature".
Sign three times (one below the other) on a plain white paper using black ink, and upload the scanned signature; it must be clear and legible.

Submit the requisite information and supporting documents for claims such as date of birth and educational qualification, along with the URN, CAF, and Examination Specific Module (including fee and centre selection); failure to provide required information/documents will result in cancellation of candidature.

(For Section Officers' LDCE) Take a printout of the completed online application by 06.10.2026, and submit the complete printed copy to your respective Ministry/Department for verification/certification. Your Ministry/Department will forward it to the concerned Cadre Controlling Authority (CCA), with a copy endorsed to the Commission, so that it reaches UPSC by the prescribed date of 23.10.2026, addressed to the Under Secretary (E-VI), Union Public Service Commission, Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi–110069.
Download the e-Admit Card from the Commission's website once issued, on the last working day of the week preceding the examination date; no admit card will be sent by post.
Applicants are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as an ID document for easy, effortless, and seamless verification and authentication of ID and other details.
important_instructions: Candidates should carefully refer to the Notice and Rules before filling the application to confirm eligibility; prescribed conditions cannot be relaxed. Candidates must finally select their preferred examination centre before submitting the application (Section Officers' LDCE); no request for change of centre will be entertained under any circumstances. Admission to the examination at all stages is purely provisional, subject to satisfying prescribed eligibility conditions; candidature will be cancelled if found ineligible at any stage. Candidates must produce their official Identity Card at the time of the examination, along with the e-Admit Card. Signatures on the application form, Attendance List, and correspondence with the Commission must be identical; any variation may lead to cancellation of candidature. No correspondence will be entertained to change any entries made in the application form after submission, as forms are processed by a computerized system. Candidates are not entitled to any Travelling Allowance from the Commission for attending the examination. Only candidates whose printed copy of the online application is forwarded by the concerned CCA (for the Section Officers' LDCE) will be considered for admission to the examination; the Commission is not responsible for non-receipt or delay in receipt of applications, and late applications will be summarily rejected. Applicants must provide a valid and active email ID while creating their account, as the Commission may use electronic mode to contact candidates. A one-time facility is available to update/modify the URN Profile; changes will apply only to applications submitted after the URN Profile is re-locked, not to applications already submitted. All communications regarding an application should be addressed to the Under Secretary (E.VI), UPSC, Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi-110069, and must include: name and year of examination, URN, Application Number, Roll Number (if received), full name in block letters, complete postal address, and valid registered email ID and mobile number. Communications lacking these particulars may not be attended to.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: These are two Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations notified by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on 16.09.2026: the Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026, and the Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE for the years 2022, 2023 & 2024. Both are restricted to eligible serving government employees.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: The online application can be filled from 16.09.2026 to 06.10.2026 (till 06:00 PM) for both examinations. For the Section Officers' LDCE, the printed copy of the application must reach UPSC through the prescribed channel by 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. When is the UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026 exam?
faq.answer: Both examinations will be held on 12th and 13th December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the categories/services under UPSC Section Officers' Grade-B LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Six categories are notified: Category I (Central Secretariat Service), Category II (Indian Foreign Service, Branch 'B'), Category III (Railway Board Secretariat Service), Category VIII (Intelligence Bureau), Category X (Armed Forces Headquarters Civil Service), and Category XI (Employees' State Insurance Corporation).

faq.question: Q5. What is the eligibility for UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Both are Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations open only to eligible serving government employees, as per Rules published by DoPT in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026. Specific qualification and service-related eligibility conditions are not detailed in the provided notification excerpt; candidates should refer to the full official notification and Rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register on https://upsconline.nic.in, complete Account Creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form, then fill the Examination Specific Module for the relevant exam between 16.09.2026 and 06.10.2026. Section Officers' LDCE applicants must also submit a printed copy through proper channel to UPSC by 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where are the UPSC Section Officers' LDCE 2026 exam centres?
faq.answer: The Section Officers' Grade-B LDCE will be held at Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Nagpur. Exam centre details for the Stenographers' LDCE are not specified in the provided notification excerpt.
